Ana: Quick q — how are we assigning partner-owned accounts for SI co-sell this quarter? Need a crisp ops model: who queues, when we escalate to field, and how to mark marketplace-qualified deals. cc @Sam H.
Sam H.: My proposal: primary owner = SI AE by default. If account is new or >$100k ARR, partnerships takes ownership for initial intro then hands back to SI. Escalation to field if deal hits salesengine stage 3 or above. Use labels in Salesforce: Partner_Owner / Redwood_Owner. :point_up:
Kevin Li: +1. Also suggest weekly pipeline cleanup. I'll paste a simple mapping we can use in SFDC import:
```
account_name,vertical,partner,partner_owner,redwood_owner,esc_level
Acme Corp,FinServ,SparkSI,jdoe@spark.com,ana@redwood.com,field
Nimbus Health,Healthcare,WellBuilt,mmartin@wb.com,sam@redwood.com,partner
``` 
Maria V.: For AWS marketplace deals — treat marketplace-sourced leads as marketplace-owned until SI has an active engagement. If marketplace-bot indicates listing = "private" then escalate to partnerships ops.
marketplace-bot: Listing status for Acme Corp => public (verified) :white_check_mark:
Ana: OK this is useful. Action items: (1) Kevin to drop SFDC import template to the drive; (2) Sam to write short SOP for >$100k exceptions; (3) Maria to add marketplace-listing flag to SFDC. I'll run a 15-min sync on Friday. :calendar:
Sam H.: Sounds good. I'll draft SOP and ping for review.
Kevin Li: Uploading CSV in #partnerships-assets now.
Maria V.: Will add the flag and update the lead intake form.
Ana: Thanks team — let's keep the handover window to 48 hours unless there are technical obstacles. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
